    why_not: >

  - type: realized_by

Fixture only, for E4-L3-T1 and E4-L3-T3. `kazi:goal-<id>` resolves directly to
`<id>` with no lookup into `planned` — here, `"warnings-clean"`, the real
goal id `portfolio-populated.json`'s `by_repo` carries four times across four
worktrees (the multi-run case E4-L3-T3 depends on).
